messages.content: 你能否發送一封電子郵件給我的同事，地址為john.doe@example.com，主題為“項目更新”，內容為“親愛的約翰，項目進展如計劃，我們將按時完成任務。謝謝你，亞歷克斯”，然後把這封信寄送副本給我的經理，地址為manager@example.com，並傳送密件副本給人力資源，地址為hr@example.com？之後，你能否再發送一封電子郵件給我的另一位同事，地址為jane.doe@example.com，主題為“會議提醒”，內容為“親愛的珍妮，這是明天上午10點我們預定的會議提醒。謝謝你，亞歷克斯”，並把這封信寄送副本給我的助理，地址為assistant@example.com，並傳送密件副本給人力資源，地址為hr@example.com？

function.name: send_email
function.description: Send an email to the specified email address. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

to.description: The email address to send to.

body.description: The body content of the email.

cc.description: The email address to carbon copy. default is ''.

bcc.description: The email address to blind carbon copy. the value is set to '' for default.

We should respond with calls to the function. According to instructions, we should not mention the tool usage or internal details. Just produce the function calls. The system says "When calling a function, you should output a JSON object with name and arguments." So we need to output JSON objects for each function call. But do we need to separate them? Usually we can output multiple calls sequentially. The system says "If you want to call a function, you should output a JSON object with name and arguments." It doesn't specify how to handle multiple calls. In previous examples, they might output one call at a time. But here we need to send two emails. We could either combine into one call if the function supports sending multiple recipients? But the function signature only has single to, cc, bcc. For first email: to: john.doe@example.com, subject: 项目更新, body: ... cc: manager@example.com, bcc: hr@example.com. For second email: to: jane.doe@example.com, subject: 会议提醒, body: ..., cc: assistant@example.com, bcc: hr@example.com.

Thus we need to make two calls. We'll output two JSON objects sequentially. The system may interpret the first as a function call, then after receiving result, we can proceed to next. But we can't know the result until we get response from tool. But we can just output the first call. Then after tool returns, we can output second. But the instruction says "When calling a function, you should output a JSON object with name and arguments." So we should output the first call. Then wait for tool response. Then output second call. But the user asked to send both. We can do it stepwise. Let's output the first call.
